meta.title: International Trading & Sourcing
meta.description: A China-based international trading company registered in Nanning, Guangxi. GUANGXI SHAHEEN SKY TRADING CO., LTD. supports product sourcing, supplier sourcing and import and export for international buyers.

hero.description: <n>{name}</n> (<zh>{nameZh}</zh>) is a China-based international trading company focused on sourcing, importing, exporting and connecting businesses with products and supply opportunities across global markets.
hero.illustration: Decorative world map illustration centered on Nanning, Guangxi

credibility.title: On the record
credibility.caption: Registration details as shown on the company's <link>business license</link>

business.title: Six lines of business
business.description: Each line has its own page describing what it covers and how it relates to the company's registered business scope.

categories.title: Product categories available for sourcing and trade
categories.description: {count} categories drawn from the company's registered business scope. They mark areas open to sourcing and trade, not current stock.

sourcing.title: Tell us what you need
sourcing.description: Send a business inquiry describing what you are looking for. Our team reviews every inquiry against the areas the company is registered to trade in.

checklist.title: What to include in a sourcing brief

items.product: The product or product type, with any model, material or size in mind
items.quantity: The quantity you are considering, and whether it is a one-time or a repeat order
items.specification: Specifications, standards, and packaging or branding requirements
items.destination: The destination country and the date you need the goods by

process.title: A typical trade process
process.description: Eight steps from first inquiry to delivery. It is a typical process, not a fixed procedure: not every step applies to every order.

verifiable.title: A verifiable registration
verifiable.body: The company is registered in Nanning, Guangxi, and its registration can be checked directly on China's National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System.

scope.title: A transparent registered scope
scope.body: The full registered business scope is published on this site as recorded on the business license, not summarized or selectively shown.

inquiryProcess.title: A structured inquiry process
inquiryProcess.body: Every business inquiry follows the same review process, set out in full before you send one.

languages.title: Built for three languages
languages.body: The website and the inquiry form work in English, Chinese (简体中文) and Arabic (العربية).

contact.title: A single point of contact
contact.body: One inquiry reaches the team responsible for reviewing it, without needing to find the right department first.

cta.title: Ready to send a business inquiry?
cta.description: Describe what you are looking for. There is no cost to submit an inquiry, and no obligation to order.

company.title: Registered company details
company.description: These details are taken from the company's business license. The full registration record, the license image and the official register are on the company information page.
company.licenseAlt: Preview of the company's business license

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.description: Send a business inquiry for a specific request, or use the contact page for anything else. Contact channels are shown here only once the company has published one.
